about: What verifiers accept by default. 'runners': container images of the bragproof runner, by digest, for hardware-attested runs. 'github': the check workflow and the commits of it that are accepted for runs witnessed by GitHub; each of those commits pins a runner image by digest. Anything found unsound is removed, and receipts made with it stop verifying. reports: the workflow whose runs are believed for run reports.

runners.note: Runs the package under test in a jail that forbids privilege gains and is self-tested before every run.
